faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IBTRD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IBTRD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Faculty Post, 1 OA Post, 1 Attender Post, 1 Watchman Cum Gardener Post.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IBTRD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Bank's website www.indianbank.in) and send it to The Director INDSETI, IDBI Bank Upstairs, No.14, 1st Floor Pudupet Road, Tirupattur, Tirupattur Dt - 635601, by regd post, to reach by 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate/Post Graduate in relevant discipline, Matriculation for Attender, 7th Standard for Watchman/Gardener. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.answer: Yes. Shall have a flair for teaching and possess sound computer knowledge. Shall be fluent in spoken and written local language, fluency in English would be an added qualification. Skills in typing in local language are essential typing skills in English an added advantage.

faq.question: Q6. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: On contract basis at INDSETI, Tirupattur.
